tspan.tspan: FIGURE C2: Metal-Ligand transitions for XAS and XES.
A comparison of the transitions involved in X-ray Absorption
Spectroscopy (XAS) and X-ray Emission Spectroscopy (XES) for a transition metal complex. XAS probes excitations from
the 1s core level to unoccupied electronic states, revealing pre-edge, edge (XANES), and continuum features (NEXAFS),
which provide insights into oxidation state and coordination environment. Conversely, XES captures radiative transitions from
occupied states back to the 1s core level, yielding characteristic K
information on spin state and electronic interactions.
